newsitem.title: ITALY: Growth in Italy bad bank debt slows - Banking Assn..
newsitem.headline: Growth in Italy bad bank debt slows - Banking Assn..

text.p: The growth in non-performing loans held by Italian banks slowed to 11.6 percent in December 1996 after rising by 13.9 percent in November, Italy's banking association (ABI) said in a monthly report.
Non-performing loans on the books of commercial banks totalled 123.066 trillion lire in December, the report said.
Total bad loans, measured by their presumed recoverable value, rose 2.7 percent to 75.753 trillion lire in December after a 3.1 percent increase in November.
Gross non-performing loans amounted to 11.28 percent of all loans in December, a fall from 11.38 percent in November.
Measured by recoverable value, they fell to 6.94 percent of total bank loans in December from 6.99 percent the previous month.
